signedPairs.$note: Every status (and every flag set TRUE) that a signature ceremony writes in its own handler, as table.column=value, recorded 2026-10-29 (D5) from the ceremonies at that head. A recorded pair is governed on its table wherever it is written, even after the ceremony that signs it is removed: that is what makes removing a ceremony fail instead of teaching the gate to stop looking. The gate fails on a newly signed pair until it is recorded here (--write-baseline adds it). Remove a pair only when the status itself leaves the product, and say so in the commit.
